package.name: mdp_bridge
package.description: Hardware/communication bridges for the robot: serial_bridge_node links mdp_stm32's custom binary protocol (USART3) to topic_based_ros2_control's /joint_commands and /joint_states topics (plus /imu/data and /estop); bluetooth_bridge_node runs a BlueZ RFCOMM server socket that accepts the Android tablet's Bluetooth connection and bridges it to /android/command and /android/status.
